name: Terra ClimbPro
description: First-principles ClimbPro built for Terra: single-row docked HUD with climb categories (Cat 4–HC / Wall), VAM-based time to summit, time-adaptive shift-ahead callouts, conquered-mountain dimming, km-to-summit markers, and automatic crux/relief pins directly on Biketerra's zoomed elevation graph.

settings.label: Climb detection sensitivity
settings.description: all (>=400m @ 3% or >=200m @ 6% walls), medium (Medium & Large), large (Large Only).

settings.label: Mountain roadmap overlays on graph
settings.description: Dim conquered climb behind cursor and show km-to-summit ticks, steepest crux & relief breather pins, and checkered summit line on the zoomed graph.

settings.label: Time-adaptive shift-ahead callout
settings.description: Quiet header pill that appears only ~25s before a steep pitch jump, recovery relief, or summit.

settings.label: Show VAM time-to-summit (ETA)
settings.description: Estimate remaining climbing time using smoothed vertical ascent rate (VAM).

settings.label: Approach pop-up distance (m)
settings.description: Distance before a climb base where ClimbPro expands and zooms.

settings.label: Zoom on-screen elevation graph
settings.description: Zoom Biketerra's elevation SVG onto the active or inspected climb and restore afterward.

settings.label: Zoom padding before/after climb (m)
settings.description: Extra metres shown before the climb start and past the summit when zoomed.

settings.label: Replace Biketerra Grade & Draft dials
settings.description: Hide Biketerra's native Grade and Draft circles while docked and show them inside Terra ClimbPro.

settings.label: Flat-road display
settings.description: When not near or on a climb: show a compact summary bar, keep next climb expanded, or auto-hide.
